{{Top|canon=Line-of-battle}}
A '''line of battle''', also called '''battle line''' or simply '''line''', was a level of organization for [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] within a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Usually it was the lowest unit above a single [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and beneath the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]].

==Old Republic==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the level above a single ship was a called a section. Sections were commanded by the most senior ship captain present, unless there was a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]].<ref name="CWC">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

A section was called a '''line''' when it was made up of larger and heavier armed ships, so-called ''ships of the line''. These lines were organized in groups of 3-4 ships.

'''Flotillas''' were composed of smaller ships like [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] or [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol craft]] operated in sections of 6-12 ships.<ref name="CWC" />

==Galactic Empire==
[[File:Imperial-I-SD-ANH.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A single ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer was a complete Line]]

Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] had several kinds of ''lines'', each suited for a different task. Each line had four ships, but in reality, these number varied. At [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the lines actually consisting of four ships made up around seven percent of the Imperial Navy.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> A line usually had 1-20 ships, commanded by a [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Captain of the Line]].<ref name="REC">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref><ref name="ISB" />

An '''attack line''' was composed of either six [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruisers]] and [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] or three [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruisers]]. Its mission profile was to engage other capital ships of similar size or to draw away enemy fire from [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]<ref name="ISB" />

A '''heavy attack line''' consisted of four to eight ships, none smaller than a light cruiser,<ref name="ISB" /> sometimes even a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="FOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref> On the battlefield, this line was able to come even against the same number of enemy capital ships and could operate independently from central command.<ref name="ISB" />

'''Pursuit lines''' were made up of light cruisers<ref name="ISB" /> and sometimes corvettes and even frigates,<ref name="FOP" /> operating in numbers of 4-10 ships. On the battlefield, pursuit lines engaged retreating ships and followed them to their base. A popular tactic employed by the these lines was [[Beambaiting]].<ref name="ISB" />

A '''recon line''' had two or four ships, often light cruiser with improved sublight speed and improved [[Hyperwave signal interceptor]]s. These ships operated alone or in pairs, tracking down Rebel bases. Often recon lines are sent into enemy territory to actively look for hostile bases and fleets. However, their mission is not to actively engage the enemy, but to retreat and report their findings.<ref name="ISB" />

[[File:ImpLine.png|thumb|right|250px|An Imperial Skirmish Line]]

'''Skirmish lines''' engage enemy capital ship or starfighters. This role was later mostly taken over by the increasing number of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], however these lines now serve as cover and provide cover fire for them. Skirmish lines consist of 4-20 ships, mostly corvettes,<ref name="ISB" /> but also [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray blastboats]] and frigates.<ref name="FOP" /> These lines were sometimes used as a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] escort.<ref name="AJ2" />

The '''torpedo line''' consisted of only two [[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|Torpedo Spheres]] and was used for planetary bombardment.<ref name="ISB" />

A '''troop line''' had only four ships, two [[Evakmar-KDY transport]] or ''Delta''-class troop transports<ref name="ISB" /><ref name="FOP" /> and two [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]].<ref name="ISB" /><ref name="FOP" /> Due to the strict level of organization within the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], this line was the most consistent within the Navy.

The '''Star Destroyer line''' consisted of only a single [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]],<ref name="ISB" /> but also a [[Super-class Star Destroyer|''Super''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="FOP" /> At the beginning of the expansion of the Navy, a study concluded that an ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer was equivalent to a [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]]. However, to acquire more Star Destroyers, the [[Admiralty (Imperial)/Legends|Admiralty]] classified the Star Destroyer as a line, since there were more lines than squadrons.

==Rebel Alliance==
[[File:LineRebel.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Organization of a Main Battle Line.]]
Due to the nature of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], an organized fleet structure was nearly impossible to keep. Single [[Sector Force/Legends|sector forces]] differed too much to form a single unified stricture. When the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] joined the Rebellion and donated their [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]], the new [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] formed so-called ''Roving Battle Lines''.<ref name="RSB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>

A line consisted of 3-10 [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] plus any number of escorts, close support vessels and starfighters. The lines were mobile and engaged the Empire only when necessary, sometimes drawing forces from the local [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="RSB" /> If necessary, a line disbanded for a while in order to avoid detection by the Empire.<ref name="AJ2">{{JournalCite|2|The Prophecy}}</ref> A Battle Line was commanded by the most senior ship captain or a Line Admiral.<ref name="RSB" />

A battle line had several sub-elements, but these seldom operated alone:

The '''Cruiser element''' formed the backbone of the line and had the most firepower. They engaged similar-sized ships of the enemy.<ref name="RSB" />

The '''Close Support element''' was made up of frigates and corvettes and had the duty to protect the cruisers from enemy close support ships. While their role was defensive, these ships would launch offensives as well, depending on the battlefield situation.<ref name="RSB" />

'''Picket elements''' were [[Fast-attack patrol ship]] and other picket ship, for example [[Light freighter/Legends|Light freighters]]. These ships were responsible for detecting approaching enemies and early engagements to force the enemy into battle formation.<ref name="RSB" />

The '''Starfighter element''' had two roles: '''Starfighter escort''' stayed close to the capital ships and engaged attacking enemy fighters, while '''Attack Starfighters''' penetrated the enemy's close support line to attack the cruisers.<ref name="RSB" />

==New Republic==
The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] basic level of organization above a single ship was the [[Task force/Legends|task force]]. From their structure, they were similar to the Roving Battle Lines of the Rebellion.<ref name="RSB" /> A task force consisted of a single Star Destroyer or Carrier as flagship, two heavy cruisers, two transports or carrier, three frigates and four gunships. Additional support ships brought the average number of ships in a task force up to 21. A task force was usually commanded by a [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] or an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]].<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>
